n-post-quantum.title: Post-quantum coins
n-post-quantum.summary: Coins that market themselves on post-quantum cryptography and the "bunker mode" debate. On 2026-10-07 Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake posted a call for the industry to "calmly begin planning for 'bunker mode'", recommending a controlled mass migration of assets to fresh addresses whose public keys stay hidden behind a hash; coverage ties the call to AI-accelerated math breaking wallet cryptography. The same day Vitalik Buterin posted that he does not recommend scrambling to move funds today but that risks to cryptography from AI-accelerated math, next to quantum, should be taken seriously, and The Block reported Europol urging the industry to prepare for quantum threats. pqc.market describes launching pump.fun coins with hash-based post-quantum attestations (WOTS one-time keys, Merkle identities); its own coin PQC and the coins QI (Quantum Inu), Tardigrade, Quantcum and BNKR (Bunker Coin) say in their metadata that they launched with its post-quantum proofs, and BUNKER (Bunker Mode) describes vaults with separate hash-based authorization. All six pools were created after the 2026-10-07 posts. None is shown to be affiliated with Drake, the Ethereum Foundation or Europol, and the coins' security claims are not verified. Measured: six coins across all their pools.

summaries.n-tokenized-assets: Coins whose metadata describes tokenized stocks or real-world assets (RWAs). @RobinhoodCrypto posted on 2026-10-08 that it is exploring a Stock Token linked to an actively managed ETF with T. Rowe Price DA ("if successful"), and on 2026-09-08 that Robinhood Stock Tokens had reached $150M in TVL on Robinhood Chain. Apps built around those tokens have coins of their own: Borro.Markets (BORRO; "Lend, borrow and short stock tokens"), HyperDex (HYDX; "Unified Marketplace for Tokenized Assets & RWAs"), Prism Assets (PRISM; "tokenising real-world assets with AI"), Longbow (BOW; borrow USDG against tokenized stocks and RWAs), Quanta Pools (QUANTA; liquidity across Stock Tokens and RWAs), Mintfolio (MINTFOLIO; baskets of stocks and ETFs), opcode (OP; "The RWA prop AMM for every chain") and TARTAGLIA (TATA; "ZK dark pool for tokenized stocks"). On Solana, Tokenize Everything (EVERYTHING; pool created 2026-10-07) describes tokenized RWAs as the biggest crypto meta of the last year and a half; one 2026-10-07 post by @RaOnChain called it a scam. None of the coins is shown to be issued by or affiliated with Robinhood, and their product descriptions are their own claims. Measured: nine coins across all their pools.

n-post-quantum.notice: Justin Drake (Ethereum Foundation researcher) posted on 2026-10-07 a call to calmly begin planning for "bunker mode" (migrating assets to addresses whose public keys stay hidden behind a hash); Vitalik Buterin posted the same day that he does not recommend scrambling to move funds today but that AI-accelerated math and quantum risks to cryptography deserve to be taken seriously; The Block reported Europol urging preparation for quantum threats. The coins launched on pqc.market after the posts.
n-post-quantum.interpretation: The cryptography-risk debate is real and recent, and these coins market themselves on it. The coins are not shown to be affiliated with the people or agencies quoted, their post-quantum claims are their own and unverified, and the debate itself is about possible risks, not a demonstrated break.

k-post.reason: Post-quantum coins qualify: QI, PQC, Tardigrade, Quantcum and BNKR name post-quantum cryptographic proofs on pqc.market in their metadata and BUNKER (Bunker Mode) names hash-based authorization: six coins and about $19.4M of rolling 24h volume against the $500K bar, all on pump.fun. It resolves the k-quantum lead deferred yesterday (two coins, project-only source). SNOOP ("Tag me under any post") matched on the word post only. Quantum-themed coins that are not post-quantum cryptography are not added: qOMPUTE and QUBIT (quarantined, extreme 24h moves), the second QI contract (quarantined, implausible market cap), two Quantum Cat coins, QOAT and qpepe (quantum-random meme coins). At the cap it replaces n-inference-credits, the smallest narrative.

k-super.reason: Super Intelligent Beauty (SIB): three contracts named SIB or similar (two SIB, about $3.67M and $0.99M, plus PERSUASION with empty metadata). Posts on 2026-10-10 say Elon Musk replied "Super Intelligent Beauty" to an AI video from @tetsuoai; that is a one-day meme, not the White House "Super Intelligence" rename behind n-super-intelligence, and only one of the SIB contracts has metadata ("Fees to @tetsuoai via UsePaid"). Fewer than three coins name one story; revisit if the Musk reply keeps spawning coins with metadata.
